title: Continuity, Dependency, Stale-Reference & Update Diagnostics
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic continuity, dependency, stale-reference and update diagnostics over MAS-01..17 while preserving canonical owner truth and keeping diagnostics, remediation proposals and update analysis distinct from canonical mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent deterministic Adventure continuity/dependency diagnostics and stale-reference/update analysis without silently rewriting canonical owner data or applying updates merely because a diagnostic exists.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically diagnose continuity, dependency and stale-reference/update conditions over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner references and fail-closed invalid states while keeping diagnostics and remediation proposals non-mutating until canonical owners authorize change.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-17, including current MSLR/MSWI planning, and unlocks no new cross-program rotation at this milestone; MAS strict-order continuation therefore selects MAS-18.
This checkpoint selects MAS-18 only; it does not grant implementation authority.
No MAS-18 implementation branch exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts MAS-18.
MAS-01 through MAS-17 remain completed foundations and are not reopened silently.
Diagnostics must remain evidence/projection semantics: detecting continuity, dependency, stale-reference or update conditions must not itself mutate canonical owner state.
Detailed MAS-18 owner seams and stale/update authority boundaries are intentionally deferred to governed start and targeted dependency loading rather than invented at selection time.
MAS-19 retains Packaging, Versioning, Install, Update, Migration & Round-Trip scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-19+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start MAS-18; do not implement while selected_not_started.
